post.yt_desc:
October brought 165,000 new jobs, far above the 59,000 economists expected, while inflation ran at 3.7% in September. Before this morning's report, traders saw about a 70% chance the Fed raises rates again in December, after its first hike since 2023 in September. This video explains why the Fed hikes, what the 1980 and 2022 hiking cycles did, and what another hike would mean for your credit card, mortgage, savings, 401(k) and job.
